name: ANSI/IEEE Loss-of-voltage monitoring relay form
summary: IEEE-library form of loss-of-voltage monitoring relay: a loss-of-voltage relay changes its output for a documented absence-of-voltage condition.
description: This reference locates loss-of-voltage monitoring relay in Autodesk's IEEE-oriented voltage protection relays family. A loss-of-voltage relay changes its output for a documented absence-of-voltage condition. Schematics distinguish measurement failure, actual source loss and auxiliary-supply loss where the design requires them. The public library uses HCR1F39 for its horizontal representation; this is a vendor block name, not an IEEE standards symbol number.

Trace the measured quantity or initiating control signal separately from the output contacts. The device tag links the sensing or operating element to the controlled circuit; settings, reset behaviour and the actual terminal arrangement belong in the selected equipment documentation.

Trace the monitored voltage independently from relay auxiliary power. Loss-of-voltage indication is not necessarily the same function as breaker undervoltage release. The linked functional counterpart explains the same operating role in its own drawing context; agreement of every detailed convention mark is not asserted.
